t: What is better than charity followed by injury
a: ۞ قَوْلٌ مَّعْرُوفٌ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ خَيْرٌ مِّن صَدَقَةٍ يَتْبَعُهَآ أَذًى ۗ وَٱللَّهُ غَنِىٌّ حَلِيمٌ
p: Qawlun maʿrūfun wa maghfiratun khayrun min ṣadaqatin yatbaʿuhā adhā…
m: Kind speech and forgiveness are better than charity followed by injury. And Allāh is Free of need and Forbearing.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
